title: MV How do you add more to in-game menu/ Menu Command?

posts.author: LittleDevil
posts.body:
So I can see when you go to the database you can uncheck menu commands like 'Formation' or 'Skill'. But how do I add new ones. Like for example, add a enemy list, just pause the game and there it is with the Item, Options and Save. Now I know there's a way to make a item you can look at in the item menu. But I don't want that. Is there a way to ass a new Menu Command?
I apologize I'm not very good at RPG Maker yet and I stopped for a while and forgot how some stuff works lol.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
You use plugins. Look up whatever you want, and they will typically automatically add an item to the menu.
There are several Encyclopedia/Bestiary plugins.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
Basically you'll need to reprogram the menu, and program new scenes for the new screens you want to add.
there are quite a number of plugins that already do something like that, for example yanfly's main menu manager.
